evidence.quote: The observations of the two lines were made at different times; therefore, it is possible that variability has affected the ratio of their fluxes.

limitations_admitted.value: continuum from the line-emitting source is contaminated by dust

evidence.quote: The continuum flux from the line-emitting source is difficult to estimate due to contamination with dust continuum emission.
Unfortunately, there is some uncertainty about the collisional broadening coefficients

limitations_admitted.value: distance is uncertain (Gaia parallax suspected unreliable)

evidence.quote: However, as argued by (cite: olofetal19) there are reasons to suspect that this distance is not correct

referee_caveats_inferred: Line identification rests on a single-zone strict-LTE model with free parameters tuned to two lines, so the identification is not unique and Na/Fe/Mg blends cannot be separated observationally
The Band 7 continuum is dust contaminated and the two lines come from different epochs and different array resolutions, so the 26alpha/30alpha ratio is uncertain
No formal uncertainties or parameter posteriors on T, nH, R or mass; only a hand-picked reference model within a solution polygon
Mass scales strongly with the assumed distance of 1 kpc, which is itself uncertain

data_public_as_stated.value: optical UVES spectra retrieved from the ESO archive; ALMA project codes listed

evidence.quote: The archive of the European Southern Observatory (ESO) contains some excellent high-resolution spectra of HD 101584.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2012.1.00248.S, #2015.1.00078.S and #2018.1.00753.S.

missing_for_reproduction: LTE model code and grid settings are not released
Imaging parameters (cell, image size, masking, line-free channels, niter/threshold) are not given
Mapping of projects to datasets TA1-TA4 and CASA versions are not given
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Roughly 100-300 GB raw for the four datasets (long Band 6 baselines, 1920-channel windows); tens of GB calibrated
reproducibility.score_reason: Data are listed by project code and the observational numbers (line fluxes, widths, continuum) can be re-measured, but imaging settings are missing and the LTE model code is not released, so the main model results cannot be rebuilt exactly.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The main results come from a custom LTE model whose code is not public and whose fitting is a hand-picked reference solution; imaging details needed for a faithful ALMA reduction are missing.

methods_papers.why: Earlier ALMA study of the same object: systemic velocity, CCS component and molecular line data re-used here
VLTI/PIONIER dust-disc structure used to motivate the face-on thin-disc geometry
Rydberg formula for RTL rest frequencies and fine-structure energies

companion_papers.why: Previous ALMA study of HD 101584 circumstellar environment
Interferometric imaging of the inner dust rim
